scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.ci:all: npm run ci:frontend && npm run ci:backend
scripts.deploy: npx --prefix backend/functions firebase deploy --config firebase.json --project rifasaderidos2026
scripts.deploy:functions: npx --prefix backend/functions firebase deploy --config firebase.json --project rifasaderidos2026 --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: npx --prefix backend/functions firebase deploy --config firebase.json --project rifasaderidos2026 --only hosting
scripts.deploy:rules: npx --prefix backend/functions firebase deploy --config firebase.json --project rifasaderidos2026 --only firestore:rules,storage
